_note: Built-in combos per champion (ComboPresets). Each entry: kind (trade|allin), nameKo, sequence of palette slot ids (P/Q/W/E/R, AA, curated variant slots such as Q2, Ignite, Flash), and the community-guide sources it came from (found by web search 2026-10-12, remaining champions 2026-10-16; WebSearch summaries of Mobalytics/Mobafire/Metabot/1v9 etc.). Play advice, not game data. A recast whose second press deals no separate damage is listed once (see 'adjusted'), because the calculator counts every node. Validated by ComboPresetsTests.

Aatrox.note: Mobalytics' shorter trade is Q then E mid-animation to land the sweet spot.
Flash mid-air on Q3 to land the sweet spot; post-6 variants open with R.

Fiora.note: Tacter adds a Tiamat active before the last AA (item actives skipped).
Hit a vital with each step.

Jax.adjusted: guide order E-Q-E-AA-W-AA; E recast ends the same E: one E hit
Jax.note: Second E is the recast (stun) mid-leap.

Riven.note: Exitlag's beginner version: W AA Q.

Renekton.note: Source is a Wild Rift guide (skill numbers mapped to Q/W/E); same pattern as the PC all-in minus Flash/R.

Irelia.adjusted: guide order E-E-Q-AA; first E press only places the blade: one E hit
Irelia.note: Pre-6; finish with Q back to a minion.

Irelia.adjusted: guide order E-R-Flash-Q-E-AA-Q-AA-Q-W-Q; first E press only places the blade: one E hit

Yone.adjusted: guide order E-Flash-R-Q-W-AA-AA-Q-E; E return is not a separate hit

LeeSin.note: r/LeeSinMains wiki variant opens with AA: AA Q E R Q2.

Khazix.note: Recast R to re-stealth, then E away.

Viego.note: Metabot orders it E W Q R AA.

Kayn.note: E through a wall, W, Q back into the wall.

Kayn.adjusted: guide order E-W-Q-R-R; R exit is the same R hit
Kayn.note: Shadow-form version; Dexerto says the Rhaast combo uses the same order.

Elise.note: Metabot's gank order: Q E R QSpider WSpider AA.

Ekko.note: Short burst variant: E Q R AA.

MasterYi.note: W right after the first AA lands to reset the attack.

JarvanIV.note: Mobalytics' rift page also lists Q Flash E R AA.

Zed.note: Metabot orders it W Q E AA.

Zed.adjusted: guide order W-R-W-E-Q-R; final R press only swaps back; the mark pop is the one R hit
Zed.note: Mobafire's all-in: R AA E Q AA Ignite.

Yasuo.note: Some guides use E Q AA (E-Q circle).

Sylas.adjusted: guide order E-Flash-E-AA-Q-AA-W-AA-AA; E1 dash deals nothing; the chain (E2) is the E hit

Leblanc.note: W back out after the AA.
R mimics W to get into range.

Akali.note: Exitlag's kill combo differs: Q AA E E2 Q R R2.

Syndra.adjusted: guide order Q-E-W-W; W pick-up deals nothing; the throw is the W hit
guide order Q-W-W-E-Flash-R; W pick-up deals nothing; the throw is the W hit

Orianna.note: Mobalytics' featured all-in: R + Flash, then Q W AA E.

Viktor.note: Alternate: Q Flash E R AA AA.

Lux.adjusted: guide order E-AA-E; E recast detonates the same zone: one E hit
Lux.note: Recast E right before the AA lands.

Lux.adjusted: guide order Q-E-R-E; E recast is the same E hit; AA consumes the passive

Fizz.adjusted: guide order Q-AA-W-E-E; E recast is the same E hit
guide order Q-R-E-E-AA-W; E recast is the same E hit
Fizz.note: R mid-Q-dash to hide the shark.

Jhin.note: Land the 4th shot after the W root.

Kaisa.note: Tacter variant: W R AA Q E.

Ezreal.note: Land W first, detonate with Q.

Lucian.note: Extended trade; no sourced combo includes R.

Pyke.note: R once the target is in execute range.

Blitzcrank.note: Source page is ARAM; the hook combo is mode-independent.
op.gg: Q E R; aramonly suggests R before E vs. mobile targets.

Zyra.adjusted: guide order R-E-W-W-Q; second W seed adds no damage of its own

Akshan.adjusted: Guide order AA-Q-AA-E-R-E; the final E recast only exits the swing (no separate hit), so E is listed once.

Alistar.note: Cast Q right as W connects; E then auto for the Trample stun.

Ambessa.note: Short poke: Q1, auto, then recast Q2 and back off.

Amumu.note: Flash mid-R animation to extend its range, then W Q E AA.

Anivia.note: Time E so it lands right after Q chills the target for double damage.

Anivia.adjusted: Guide order Q-Q-W-E-R-AA-E-R; Q detonate recast and the R toggle-off listed once.
Anivia.note: W behind the target, then E and R under them.

Annie.note: Surprise trade; best with stun ready.
At 3-4 passive stacks, E then W so the stun comes up for Flash-R.

Aphelios.note: Calibrum main: Q and R instantly, then AA twice to pop the marks.

Aphelios.adjusted: Guide order R-Q-W-Q (Infernum main, Severum off); W is a weapon swap with no damage and is omitted.
Aphelios.note: Cast R, Q, W instantly one after another, then Q.

AurelionSol.note: Singularity pulls them in, breathe Q while they are inside.
Fly in with W, breathe Q, then E-R and finish with another Q.

Aurora.adjusted: Guide: Q-AA-E-Q; the Q recast is listed once (no separate Q2 slot).
Guide: R-Q-E-W-Q with teleports at the R edges; the final Q recast is listed once (no separate Q2 slot).

Azir.note: Soldier autos; Q repositions soldiers onto the target.
Shurima Shuffle: Q mid-dash toward the target, R them back to your team.

Bard.note: Gank: R then E toward the target, Q stun as they leave stasis.
Flash to line Q up with a wall or second target for the stun.

Braum.adjusted: Guide W-AA-Q-AA-AA; P added for the Concussive Blows stun proc on the 4th stack.
Guide Q-AA-R-AA-AA; P added for the passive proc on the 4th stack.

Briar.note: Guide lists W, W, Q, E: the second W press is the Snack Attack bite.

Cassiopeia.note: Only commit after Q lands; spam E on the poisoned target.

Chogath.note: Hold R as the true-damage execute.

DrMundo.adjusted: Guide: Q -> W activate -> auto with E. W listed once (activation and recast are one damage source).

Evelynn.note: Flash-E-Q as Allure is about to complete, then AA and R after the Q animation.

Fiddlesticks.note: Terrify, Flash in, drain with W and silence with E.
Flash as the R channel completes, then Q-E-W back to back.

Galio.adjusted: Guide: Q-AA(passive proc)-E-W; the passive-empowered auto is the P node.
Guide: AA-E(backwards)-Q-AA-W-W(recast at max charge)-AA-AA; the W charge+release is listed once, and the auto after E+Q is the passive (P).

Gangplank.adjusted: Guide: E-AA-AA-Q(barrel)-AA; the two autos only lower barrel health and deal no champion damage, so they are dropped.
Gangplank.note: Q the barrel once it is one hit from exploding.

Gangplank.adjusted: Guide: E-E-Q-Flash-E; the chained barrels detonate onto the target as one explosion, so E is listed once.

Gnar.note: Mini Gnar; aim for the third-hit W proc.

Gnar.adjusted: Guide order E-AA-R-AA-W-AA-Q-AA with 'E and Flash before R'; the opening AA dropped to fit E-Flash-R.
Gnar.note: Transform first; R into a wall.

Gragas.adjusted: Guide: W-R-E-Q-AA-Q; the second Q is the barrel detonation (no separate hit), listed once.
Gragas.note: Alt engage: E-Flash-R into Q. Q-R can be cast during E.

Gwen.note: Stack passive with autos for more Q snips, dash in with E, then Q.

Gwen.adjusted: Guide R-AA-E-AA-R-Q-AA-W-R-Flash; R recasts have no distinct slot so R is listed once, trailing W and Flash dropped (no damage).

Hecarim.note: R behind the target and Q them mid-air.

Heimerdinger.adjusted: Guide: R-Q-E-Q-W-AA; the R press is folded into the empowered turret (QUlt).
Heimerdinger.note: Cast the empowered turret right after R, then E, Q, W as fast as possible.

Hwei.note: QQ alone is the main lane poke (Skill-Capped).

Illaoi.note: Flash during the R animation when the target is far.

Ivern.note: Self-engage: E yourself toward the enemy, then Q.
E on Daisy; Q the target while Daisy knocks it up.

Janna.note: Double-tap Q, then Flash behind the target and R to knock them into your team.

Jayce.note: Fire Shock Blast through the Acceleration Gate for the long-range poke.
Swap to Hammer: To the Skies, Lightning Field, Thundering Blow, then autos.

Kalista.note: Stack spears with autos, Q through, then Rend.

Karma.note: Flash during the empowered Q animation.

Karthus.note: E is a toggle; keep spamming Q after Flash.

Kayle.note: Use E as the second AA finishes.

Kayle.adjusted: Guide R-Flash-Q-E-EAA; the E-empowered attack is the E damage instance, so it is listed once as E.

Kennen.adjusted: Guide order E-R-Flash-W-Q-E-AA; the E recast only ends Lightning Rush (no separate damage), so E is listed once.
Kennen.note: Flank from fog; R then Flash into the backline.

Kindred.note: Execute right as R ends; third hit on E target procs Mounting Dread.

Kled.adjusted: Guide ends with a second E to dash out; the recast has no separate slot, so E is listed once.

KogMaw.note: Activate W first, then keep auto-attacking.

Ksante.adjusted: Guide: Q-AA-W-E; trailing E (Footwork dash/shield, no damage) dropped.
Guide: E-Q-W-AA-R; leading E (engage dash, no damage) dropped.

Lillia.adjusted: Guide E-Q-Flash-R-W-Q; Q has no distinct recast slot, so the final Q is dropped.
Lillia.note: Sleep them with R, finish with W as they wake.

Lissandra.adjusted: Guide order E-E(recast)-Flash-W-R-Q; the E recast is a teleport with no separate damage, so E is listed once.
Lissandra.note: Recast E at max range, then Flash-W-R yourself and Q once free.

Locke.note: Pop nail stacks with E or autos; E-first opener can catch opponents off guard.

Lulu.note: W and R on yourself; E the enemy for Pix-empowered autos.

Malphite.note: Press Q, E and W as fast as possible after landing R.

Malzahar.note: Q W quickly, Flash, then E R as fast as possible.

Maokai.note: Q then instantly W; AA and E once you arrive.

Mel.note: Root with Solar Snare so the full Radiant Volley lands, then Golden Eclipse; Flash after E for range.

Milio.note: Shield ally first, then Q kick; passive burns on allied hits.

MonkeyKing.note: R ticks lower Q's cooldown, so Q before R.

Morgana.note: E shield on yourself before flashing in; recast W when ready.

Nami.note: Self-cast W and E instantly, then AA-Q-AA-R-AA.

Nasus.note: Animation-cancel: E and W back to back, then R and Q as fast as possible.

Neeko.note: Q right after E roots for guaranteed blooms.

Nidalee.adjusted: Guide ends with a human E heal if the target survives; it deals no damage and needs another transform, so it is dropped.
Nidalee.note: A landed spear marks the target and extends Pounce range.

Nocturne.adjusted: Guide uses R twice (darkness, then dash); R listed once as it hits once.
Nocturne.note: Q and E can be cast mid-air during the R dash.

Nunu.adjusted: Guide W-E-AA-E-Q-E-AA; E barrage recasts have no distinct slot, so E is listed once.

Nunu.note: Don't press R twice right away.

Olaf.note: Auto while walking to the axe, pick it up, throw Q again.

Ornn.note: E into the Q pillar for the knockup.

Ornn.adjusted: Guide: Q-R-W-AA-R(recast)-E; the R recast is listed once (no separate R2 slot).

Poppy.note: E into a wall for the stun.

Quinn.note: Proc Harrier marks with autos between spells.

Quinn.adjusted: Guide: R forward, AA, Q, AA, E; leading R (Behind Enemy Lines travel, no damage without Skystrike) dropped.
Quinn.note: Flash can cancel the animation after the E knockback.

Rakan.note: W as soon as the R lockout ends for a guaranteed engage.

Rammus.note: Roll in, taunt the priority target, W to reflect, R for area damage.

RekSai.adjusted: Guide: E(tunnel)-Flash-W-AA-Q-AA-E-AA; the opening burrowed tunnel deals no damage and is omitted so it isn't counted as the unburrowed E bite.

Rell.note: Flash before W, not after, or the jump may miss.

Renata.adjusted: Guide order R-Summoner-Q-Q-E; Q recast (throw) listed once, summoner assumed Flash.

Rengar.note: Gank from brush; second Q is the empowered (ferocity) Q, a separate cast.
Second Q is a fresh cast, not a recast.

Rumble.adjusted: Guide R-E-Flash-Q-W-AA-E-AA; the second harpoon has no distinct slot, so E is listed once.

Ryze.note: E resets Q; the second Q spreads to Fluxed targets.

Seraphine.note: Flash instantly after R to extend its range; R-E-Q-W without Flash also works.

Shaco.note: Use the clone to bait, then Deceive in behind for Backstab.

Shen.note: E cancels the auto attack backswing.
Q mid-air during E, then autos.

Shyvana.note: Guide says E as soon as you land from R; in dragon form that E is the dragon-form EDragon.

Singed.note: Cast W behind you, then Fling the target into it.

Sion.adjusted: Guide: E-Q-W-AA-AA-W; W's first press is the shield and only the recast deals damage, so W is listed once.
Guide: W-Q-E-W-AA-R-AA; W's shield press and its damaging recast are listed once.

Sivir.note: W resets the auto; plain AA-Q-AA is the easy version.
Q at max range so both passes hit; Flash as Q lands.

Skarner.adjusted: Guide: Q-E-AA-Q-R-W; the second Q (rock throw recast) has no separate slot, listed once.

Sona.note: At two Power Chord stacks: AA, Q, then the Power Chord auto (listed as P).
Engage with R, instantly Q, then the empowered auto (listed as P).

Swain.adjusted: Guide: E-W-E-Q-AA; the E recast only pulls rooted enemies, so E is listed once.
Guide: Q-Flash-E-W-R-E-AA-R; the E recast pull deals no separate damage, so E is listed once.

Taliyah.note: W into the E minefield to detonate the boulders.

Taric.note: Weave two passive-empowered autos after each spell.

Taric.adjusted: Guide W-R-E-Flash-AA-AA-Q-AA-AA-Q; Q has no distinct recast slot, so the final Q is dropped.
Taric.note: Flash before the E stun activates.

Teemo.note: Auto to apply Toxic Shot poison, blind with Q, back off with W.

Tristana.adjusted: Guide ends with W away to disengage; omitted since that jump lands away from the enemy.
Guide: W in, then E and R; one auto added to stack E before R.

Trundle.note: Place E behind the target to block its escape.

Tryndamere.note: W as soon as E lands; E-Flash-AA to execute low targets.

TwistedFate.adjusted: Guide: AA-W-AA (Blue Card); the card auto is the W hit, so the second AA is merged into W.
Guide: W (Gold Card)-AA-Q-AA; the card auto is the W hit, so the first AA is merged into W.

Twitch.note: AA until max Deadly Venom stacks, then E.
From stealth: W and instantly R, E at max passive stacks.

Udyr.note: Approach with E, stun on the first auto, then Q autos for damage.
Skirmish: E stun, R area slow, Q burst, W for sustain.

Urgot.note: Step sideways between autos to fire more shotgun knees.

Varus.note: Three autos apply Blight stacks; E and Q pop them.
Flash mid R animation to extend the engage.

Veigar.note: W into stunned targets; R as the execute.

Velkoz.note: Three passive stacks deal true damage; hold R until targets are locked.

Vladimir.note: Charge E, Flash forward into R, then AA-Q and W to finish.

Warwick.adjusted: Guide: W-E-Flash-Q-E-AA-R; the E recast ends the howl and deals no damage, so E is listed once.

Xayah.note: Recall the Q feathers through the target for the root.
R and Flash toward the target while untargetable, then E root.

Xerath.adjusted: Guide poke: Q-W-Q; Q has no extra slot, listed once.

Yunara.adjusted: Guide: W-E-AA-R-E-AA-AA-W; the second (empowered) E dash deals no separate damage and is omitted.

Yuumi.note: Bind to an ally first; steer Q for the empowered hit.

Zaahen.note: Hit squishies with the outer edge of E.

Zac.note: Land the second Q arm on a squishy target.

Zeri.adjusted: Guide W-E-R then Q spam and autos; repeated Q has no distinct slot, so Q is listed once.

Ziggs.adjusted: Guide order AA-E-Q-R-AA-W-W-AA; the second W press only detonates the same Satchel Charge (one damage instance), so W is listed once.

Zilean.note: Second bomb on the same target detonates the first for a stun; Q-Q-W buffering is faster.

Zoe.adjusted: Guide: Q-Q-R-AA; Q's first press only sets the star and the recast deals the damage, so Q is listed once; the AA after a spell is Zoe's passive-empowered hit, recorded as P.
Guide: R-Flash-E-Q-Q; Q's two presses are one damage hit, so Q is listed once.
